title: Temporal image-intensity vehicle counting: code, annotations, signals and results
description: Code, ROI polygons, event lists of two annotators with adjudication, extracted ROI signals, detections and all raw results of the article "Temporal Image-Intensity Analysis for Low-Cost Vehicle Counting: Event-Level Evaluation and Sensitivity to Spatial Resolution" (IEEE Access, under review). The surveillance-camera recordings are not included (see README).
